tinytrail: notes for Claude

Source: CLAUDE.md

Short, durable project knowledge. Keep this file under about 60 lines: when you add something, remove or merge something outdated. No changelogs (NEWS.md has those) and nothing the code already says plainly.

Working rules

  • Default branch is master. Never push to it; work on a branch and open a draft PR. Tomas reviews, tests and merges himself.
  • Suggestions in issues are ideas, not specs. Find the root cause, weigh alternatives, and say in the PR why you chose your fix.
  • Pure R package, no compiled code. Keep it that way: Tomas installs PR branches without Rtools, from the GitHub archive/refs/heads/<branch>.tar.gz link.
  • CRAN package: keep R CMD check clean and keep dependencies light (only yaml in Imports).

Design decisions

  • Runtime: tinytrail() notes the start time and tinytrail_the_end(), placed at the end of a script, writes one script_runtime field. The latest run wins. There is no render/interactive/script label (tried and reverted in #11) and no automatic end detection: hooks on source(), knitr or R exit were removed in 0.2.0. record_runtime is deprecated and ignored.
  • Script name: a Quarto render knits a temporary report.rmarkdown, and rendering script.R knits script.spin.Rmd. Both must be recorded as the file the user wrote (report.qmd, script.R), so that a render and an interactive run share one trail entry (.knitr_source_name() in R/detect.R).
  • Automatic output recording only records files saved by the user’s own code. Writes from RStudio internals and from knitr/rmarkdown/evaluate/quarto (chunk figures, cache, plot previews) and session temp files are skipped (.called_by_tooling() in R/auto_trail.R). Explicit tinytrail_write() calls are always recorded.
  • Call-stack checks must return one value per frame: compare calls structurally (identical(call[[1]], quote(source))), never with deparse(), which returns several strings for multiline expressions (#9).

Known issues / open ideas

  • #7: missing.count option for tinytrail_dict() (enhancement, open).
